ko.title: 문부과학성에 부정 접속…16만 건 정보 유출 가능성

en.title: Unauthorized access at MEXT; data on up to 160,000 records may have leaked
en.summary: Kyodo News reported that the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology was hit by unauthorized access and information on 160,000 records may have been leaked.

zh.title: 日本文部科学省遭非法访问，16万条信息或已泄露
